title: A Systematic Analysis of Linguistic Features in AI-Generated English Text Detection Across Domains and Models
abstract: arXiv:2606.04177v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Interpretable linguistic features offer a promising approach for explaining why a given text appears machine-generated, particularly for non-expert users. However, existing findings on which features reliably indicate LLMgenerated text remain fragmented across feature sets, models, and text domains. To address this gap, we conduct a large-scale empirical study assessing the robustness of linguistic signals for characterizing AI-generated text. Our analysis covers 284 interpretable linguistic features across outputs from 30 LLMs and 10 text domains under cross-model and cross-domain generalization settings. We show that classifiers based solely on linguistic features can reliably distinguish AI-generated from human-written text. However, many previously proposed indicators prove strongly context-dependent, with the exception of measures of lexical richness, which remain robust signals across model families and text domains. translated_title: 跨领域与跨模型的AI生成英文文本检测中语言特征的系统性分析
translated_abstract: 可解释的语言特征为解释一段文本为何呈现机器生成特征提供了一种有前景的方法，尤其对非专业用户而言。然而，关于哪些特征能可靠指示大语言模型（LLM）生成文本的已有研究结论，在不同特征集、模型和文本领域之间仍然碎片化。为填补这一空白，我们开展了一项大规模实证研究，评估用于刻画AI生成文本的语言信号的稳健性。我们的分析涵盖284个可解释的语言特征，在跨模型和跨领域泛化设置下，对来自30个大语言模型和10个文本领域的输出进行评估。研究表明，仅基于语言特征的分类器能够可靠地区分AI生成文本与人类撰写的文本。然而，许多此前提出的指标被证明高度依赖于具体上下文，唯有词汇丰富度度量在不同模型家族和文本领域中始终保持稳健。这些结果表明……
tldr: 该研究通过覆盖284个可解释语言特征、30个大语言模型和10个文本领域的大规模实证分析，发现仅基于语言特征即可可靠检测AI生成文本，且词汇丰富度是唯一在跨模型、跨领域场景下保持稳健的判别信号。
en_tdlr: This large-scale empirical study of 284 interpretable linguistic features across 30 LLMs and 10 text domains shows that linguistic-feature-based classifiers can reliably detect AI-generated text, with lexical richness being the only robust signal that generalizes across models and domains.
